prompt: A clean, straight-on technical TIMING DIAGRAM of a signalling lamp flashing the word "QUARTZ" in International Morse code, drawn as a single horizontal row of exactly 61 equal square TIME-SLOT frames, left to right. Each frame is the lamp state during one time unit: a BRIGHT glowing amber square if the lamp is ON that unit, or a BLACK square if the lamp is OFF. Use the standard Morse timing: a DOT is the lamp ON for 1 frame, a DASH is the lamp ON for 3 consecutive frames, the gap between the dots and dashes WITHIN a letter is 1 OFF frame, and the gap BETWEEN letters is 3 OFF frames. There is no gap before the first letter or after the last. Fill every frame with the correct ON/OFF state for flashing QUARTZ. Thin grey frame borders, all frames the same size on one straight row, nothing else — no text, no dots, no dashes, no labels.
easy_question: Never mind how well it is drawn. Does this picture show a lamp TIMING DIAGRAM — a single row of equal square frames, each a bright (ON) or black (OFF) square? A realistic photo, an illustration, a schematic or a clean diagram ALL count as yes. Answer NO only if the image instead shows just a blank card or plain panel that prints an answer with none of that shown, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.q_frames: This is a lamp timing diagram: a single horizontal row of exactly 61 equal square frames, each either a BRIGHT/glowing square (lamp ON) or a BLACK square (lamp OFF). Reading LEFT to RIGHT, output 61 digits separated by single spaces: 1 if that frame is bright/ON, 0 if it is black/OFF. Output ONLY the digits. If unreadable answer 'unreadable'.

steps.ask: Are the small square lamp frames in this picture drawn in ONE single horizontal row, side by side? Answer yes or no only.

Write down every row of small square lamp frames drawn in this picture, working from the top down, each with a few plain words saying where on the picture it sits. Separate one item from the next with a semicolon; write no running total and nothing else. If there is no such row here, write the single word NONE.

steps.target: the block of square lamp time-slot frames

steps.read_crop: This crop shows ONE square time-slot frame of a signalling-lamp strip. Is that square BRIGHT (a glowing amber/yellow lamp that is ON) or BLACK (the lamp is OFF)? Answer with exactly one word: bright or black.
